cohort: 7691 nulliparous women delivering singleton, vertex, live births at ≥37 weeks gestation
finding: Nighttime delivery was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery, operative vaginal delivery, and neonates with a 5-minute Apgar score < 7 and umbilical artery pH < 7.0.
mod_finding: Women who delivered at night had higher odds of cesarean delivery and operative vaginal delivery compared to those who delivered during the day.
